instructions: What job does the SENTENCE do in the post?

criteria.news: the concrete announcement, request, fact or result the post exists to share
criteria.story: backstory or anecdote leading up to the point
criteria.bait: asks readers to like, comment, repost or agree
criteria.brag: self-congratulation dressed up as humility or gratitude
criteria.filler: cliche, dramatic pause or line that adds no information
